runlow.name: Runlow: AI Usage Meter
runlow.tagline: Every AI limit you are paying for, on one screen.
runlow.devices: iPhone · iPad · Mac · Apple Watch · Apple Vision Pro
runlow.keywords: AI usage tracker, Claude usage monitor, ChatGPT Codex limits, Gemini CLI quota, Cursor plan usage, GitHub Copilot requests, OpenRouter credits, token tracker, rate limit monitor, menu bar app, Lock Screen Live Activity, Dynamic Island
runlow.intro: Every AI subscription has a limit, and not one of them makes it easy to see. Runlow puts Claude, Codex, Gemini, Cursor, GitHub Copilot and OpenRouter side by side as clean colour coded meters that fill from green to red as you use them, so you know where you stand before you hit a wall in the middle of something.

sections.p: Connect any of them, or all of them. Nothing is Claude first and nothing is hidden behind a tier.
ul: Claude: your 5 hour session, weekly caps, per model lanes and extra usage credits, across as many accounts as you have
Codex (ChatGPT): 5 hour session and weekly limits
Gemini CLI: remaining quota per model, picked up automatically as Google adds or retires models
Cursor: plan usage
GitHub Copilot: premium request allowance remaining
OpenRouter: credit balance, key spend, and what you have spent today, this week and this month

sections.h: Your Lock Screen card, your way
sections.p: Pin up to eight meters to the Lock Screen as a Live Activity. Choose the headline meter, how big the top row is, whether every meter gets a bar, and where the refresh button sits. Reset times count down live. The Dynamic Island shows the two numbers you pick, in their own colours, and expands to as many as six meters.

sections.h: Seven themes and a setup wizard
sections.p: A theme sets the bar colours, the bar shape, the typeface and the background in one tap, and follows light and dark on its own. Nine typefaces. Bars in one piece or in blocks like a fuel gauge. Colour bars by the theme, by usage, by usage as a gradient along the bar, or give any meter its own colour. The setup wizard walks you through the card one question at a time with your own meters in front of you, and cancelling puts everything back.

sections.h: Widgets, your wrist and the menu bar
sections.p: Small, medium and large Home Screen widgets, the large one holding up to twelve meters with their bars and every one with a refresh button, plus Lock Screen widgets. Your focus meter on Apple Watch, in your theme. On the Mac the meters live in the menu bar next to the clock, as many as you like, side by side or stacked, with a right-click to add or remove any of them, and the same themes and wizard. On Apple Vision Pro, a dashboard window and a compact panel you can park beside your work.

sections.h: Warned before you hit the wall
sections.p: Optional notifications before you hit a wall, and again the moment a limit resets, so a long session does not end in a surprise. History charts every meter over time, with an optional forecast worked out from your own readings, a payments log for what you pay each service, and CSV export.

No account to create, no server of ours, no analytics, no tracking. Runlow reads your usage straight from each service with your own sign-in, and nothing is sent to us. Your keys are kept in the Keychain and, unless you switch it off, in your own iCloud Keychain, so pasting a key once signs in your other devices. Your settings can follow you through your own iCloud too, if you choose. A Privacy page in the app lists every address it contacts and why.

reprompt.name: Reprompt: Teleprompter
reprompt.tagline: A teleprompter that does not lose your take.
reprompt.devices: iPhone · iPad · Mac · Apple TV · Apple Watch
reprompt.keywords: teleprompter app, Mac teleprompter, script scrolling, video recording, YouTube creator tools, presentation prompter, webcam teleprompter, remote control prompter
reprompt.intro: Reprompt is a teleprompter for people who film themselves. On the Mac it is a real Mac app with a real menu bar, not an iPad app dropped into a window. It scrolls your script at your reading pace, records while it scrolls, and it does not lose your take.

sections.p: Space bar rolls and pauses. Arrow keys change speed. Command N starts a new script, Command I imports one, Escape closes the prompter. Resize the window and the text reflows. It is a desk prompter built for a webcam shoot, not a phone app in a bigger box.

Your video is committed to disk in short fragments while you record, rather than written in one go at the end. If the app is interrupted or the machine goes to sleep, the take is still there when you come back, and Reprompt tells you it survived. Recording is part of Reprompt Pro.

The teleprompter is free: mirroring, Voice Pause, the Apple Watch remote and iCloud sync, for up to three scripts. Reprompt Pro is a single £9.99 purchase that adds video recording with the takes library, unlimited scripts and file import, on iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple TV. No account, no sign up, no subscription. Bought Reprompt when it was a paid app? Pro is already yours.
ul: No watermark on your video, not on the first take and not ever
Mirroring for glass and beam splitter rigs
Every future update included

reprompt.closer: Free to download, with Reprompt Pro as a one-time unlock. No subscription, no account, no tracking.

recast.name: Recast: Convert & Compress
recast.tagline: Convert almost anything, without uploading a single file.
recast.keywords: file converter iPhone, video converter, photo converter, HEIC to JPEG, PDF to image, GIF to MP4, offline converter, compress video to size, no upload converter
recast.intro: Pick a photo, video, PDF, audio file, GIF or Live Photo, choose what you want out of it, and Recast does the rest. Every conversion happens on your device. There is no account, no upload, and no waiting on someone else's server.

sections.p: Most converters give you a quality slider and leave you guessing. Recast lets you say what the file needs to weigh, then works backwards to get there. 25 MB for most email, 20 MB for Discord, 16 MB for a WhatsApp video, or a number you pick yourself.
If full resolution cannot reach your target, Recast lowers the resolution to get there and tells you it did. If a file is already small enough, it leaves it alone and says so.

ul: Photos: JPEG, PNG, HEIC, TIFF, BMP, and into PDF
PDFs: to JPEG or PNG page by page, or compressed as PDF
Video: MP4, MOV and more, with a size target
Audio and GIFs, including Live Photos

sections.p: Everything runs on the device, so it works on a plane and it works with files you would rather not hand to a website. No account and no subscription, and Recast never asks to track you. The only time it goes online is for an advert you choose to watch, and Pro removes that.

sections.h: Free, with an optional Pro unlock
sections.p: Recast itself is free: five files on each tool to start, then one a day, and an advert whenever you want one more. Recast Pro removes the adverts and adds unlimited files, whole batches at once, images combined into one PDF, and Shortcuts, as a one time purchase, not a subscription.

recast.closer: Free to download, with Recast Pro as a one-time unlock. No account, no subscription, and your files never leave your device.

refast.name: Refast: 16:8 Fasting Timer
refast.tagline: How long is left. That is the whole idea.
refast.keywords: intermittent fasting timer, 16:8 fasting, fasting tracker, eating window, fasting streak, no subscription fasting app
refast.intro: A fasting timer that shows you the one thing you actually want to know, and does not try to be a food diary, a coach or a subscription while it is at it.

sections.p: Start your fast and the ring fills towards your goal, then keeps counting past it so you can see how far over you went. When you break the fast, it shows when your eating window closes.

Forgot to start it, or to stop it? Fix the times in a few taps, or add a fast by hand. Your streak, goal rate and this week's count are free, and Refast Plus opens your full history and long range trends, laid out to read at a glance on the Mac as well as the phone.

The timer is free. Refast Plus is a one time unlock that adds your full history, detailed trends, saved custom plans, four more themes and icons, a full backup file, and iCloud sync across iPhone, iPad and Mac. No subscription, no account, no ads, and your fasts stay on your own devices and your own iCloud.

refast.closer: Free to download and free to use as a timer, with Refast Plus as a one-time unlock. No subscription, no account, no tracking.

gainscout.name: GainScout: BNG Land Finder
gainscout.tagline: Check any field in England for Biodiversity Net Gain potential, in one tap.
gainscout.closer: Free to download, with free land checks every week. No account, no tracking. Reports and GainScout Pro are optional.
gainscout.keywords: biodiversity net gain, BNG, land check England, habitat bank, off site units, land agent, planning consultant, farmland, SSSI, agricultural land classification, flood risk, green belt
gainscout.intro: GainScout is the fastest way to take a first look at whether a piece of land in England could be a candidate for Biodiversity Net Gain, the planning rule that has developers paying landowners to make land better for nature.

sections.p: Point the map at a field and press one button. GainScout reads that exact spot against official public government datasets and gives you a clear answer in seconds, with every finding's source and the date it was checked. Nothing is estimated and nothing is invented.

ul: Statutory designations: SSSI, SAC, SPA, Ramsar, national and local nature reserves
Ancient woodland and priority habitats
Agricultural land grade, with the best and most versatile farmland flagged
Flood risk zones
Green Belt, National Landscapes and conservation areas
The Local Nature Recovery Strategy for the area
Your buyer catchment: the planning authority and National Character Area the land sits in
What developments in that authority have actually taken from the public register of gain sites
Whether the habitat and the farmland grade together leave much room to improve, or little
A warning when ground looks uncultivated or semi-natural, which can need a decision from Natural England before any work starts
The registered gain sites near the land, the supply already competing nearby, and how many have had nothing allocated yet
Save sites and track them from watching to in talks
Add a walkover checklist that says what can be surveyed this month, plus notes and timestamped evidence photos
Create a dated report with findings, sources, your photos and an OS grid reference, ready to hand to an agent, ecologist or buyer, and export it as a PDF
Works on iPhone, iPad and Mac, with sites, reports and photos synced through your own iCloud

With Pro: Area Scan to rank the most promising spots across an area, draw your parcel for instant acreage and a spot by spot check, browse every registered gain site near any land, and compare saved sites side by side

sections.h: Free to try, pay for what you need
sections.p: Free accounts get 3 land checks a week, 3 saved sites and their first report free. While GainScout is in beta, until 31 December 2026, that is 5 checks a week, 5 saved sites, 2 extra free reports and one Area Scan a week. Buy reports one at a time or ten at once, or subscribe to GainScout Pro for unlimited checks, reports and saved sites plus every Pro tool, billed monthly, quarterly or yearly, cancel any time.

gridsong.name: Gridsong: Music Maker
gridsong.tagline: Tap a grid. Nothing you play can sound wrong.
gridsong.keywords: music maker app, beat maker, loop sequencer, make music no skill, pentatonic grid, lofi, ambient, drum machine, songwriting app
gridsong.intro: Gridsong turns a glowing grid into an instrument anyone can play. Tap a square and it plays a note. Tap a few more and you have a melody, because the whole grid is locked to a musical scale, so nothing you tap can sound wrong.

sections.h: No lessons, no theory, no wrong notes
sections.p: Drag across the grid to paint a run of notes, press play, and it loops. Start from a template or a blank grid.

sections.h: What you get to play with
ul: Ten built in instruments including Bell, Pluck, Glass, Voice and Bass
Drums, with tempo, swing and key you control
Loop, duplicate and layer patterns into a full song
Record your loop as audio and share it
Patterns synced across iPhone, iPad and Mac with iCloud

sections.p: Gridsong is free to play. Gridsong Pro is a single purchase, not a subscription, that adds a deeper library of instruments, your own sounds recorded or imported and played across the grid, every template, your pattern as a vertical video, and MIDI out to Logic, GarageBand and AUM. Bought Gridsong when it was a paid app? Pro is already yours.

gridsong.closer: Free to play, with Gridsong Pro as a one-time unlock. No subscription, no account, no ads.

merestone.name: Merestone: SSSI & Habitat Map
merestone.tagline: Every statutory designation on one map, in the field, with no signal.
merestone.closer: Free to download, with every country's statutory core and a 250 m search free. Unlock a country once, or subscribe to Merestone Worldwide for all of them. No account, no tracking.
merestone.keywords: SSSI map, protected sites UK, ancient woodland, priority habitat inventory, SAC SPA Ramsar, ecology desk study, preliminary ecological appraisal, PEA, biodiversity net gain, planning constraints, AONB, Natura 2000, offline GIS
merestone.intro: Merestone puts statutory environmental designations on one map, on your phone, in the field, with or without a signal. The United Kingdom first, then Ireland, France, Spain, Portugal, the Netherlands and Belgium, with every layer drawn straight from the agency that publishes it.

sections.p: Drop a pin, choose a radius, and every designation inside it comes back sorted by distance, with anything on site flagged. Distances and bearings are measured, not eyeballed off a screen.

Export a dated PDF or text extract with a site plan, every record with its distance, direction and source, and just as importantly the layers that were checked and found nothing in. Choose which sections to include before you export.

ul: SSSI and SSSI Units, SAC, SPA and Ramsar sites, with ASSI in Northern Ireland
National and Local Nature Reserves, National Parks and AONB
Ancient woodland, the Priority Habitat Inventory, wood pasture and traditional orchards
Open access land, listed buildings and scheduled monuments
SAC, SPA, NHA and pNHA in Ireland, and Natura 2000 with each country's own designations in France, Spain, Portugal, the Netherlands and Belgium
Live species records from GBIF, as a first look rather than an inventory
England, Scotland, Wales, Northern Ireland, Ireland, France, Spain, Portugal, the Netherlands and Belgium, with the same map, searches and report throughout

sections.p: Unlock a country and download any of its layers, or all of them, and it keeps working out of signal. Merestone uses live data when you have a connection and falls back to your download when you do not, and it says which it used, on screen and in the report.

sections.h: Built for the way the work happens
ul: Grid references in the system each country actually uses, and a search that accepts them
Presets for desk study, woodland, wetland, coastal and species work, or save your own
Favourites with notes, synced through your own iCloud with no account and no server
An Apple Watch app for what is around you right now

sections.h: Free to start, pay for the countries you use
sections.p: Every country's statutory core and a 250 m search are free. Unlocking a country is a one-off purchase that covers iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple Watch and never renews, and adds that country's full set of layers, wider searches, the PDF and offline downloads. A Merestone Worldwide subscription unlocks every country instead.
